shi2012-ac2033968-cds-carbon-paper.title: Running-solution volume series
shi2012-ac2033968-cds-carbon-paper.summary: 10, 15 and20 µL operating volumes, five scans; this is measurement-solution volume, not CdS coating volume. ECL increased when running-solution volume rose from 10 to 15 µL and decreased slightly at 20 µL. The authors identify 15 µL as optimal for a thin-layer cell 1.10 cm long and 0.74 cm wide. Leakage is a proposed explanation; its volume is not measured here.
